veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: klanke wat min ander tale het
veranderings.na: klanke wat in min ander tale voorkom
veranderings.rede: As written the relative clause can be read as 'sounds that have few other languages'; this removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.voor: San-vroue maak daardie krale vandag nog.
veranderings.na: San-vroue maak vandag nog sulke krale.
veranderings.rede: 'daardie' points to the same old beads; 'sulke' means beads of that kind, and the adverb before the object is the natural order.
The fixed expression is 'van hand tot hand gaan'; objects do not 'trek'.
The sentence is in the past tense ('het gewys'), and 'verbonde aan' is the correct adjectival form for being connected to someone.
'bymekaarkom' is a separable compound verb and is written as one word when it stands together at the end of a subordinate clause.

veranderings.voor: Sang is deel van hoe hulle stories en kennis aan mekaar oordra
veranderings.na: Sang is een van die maniere waarop hulle stories en kennis aan mekaar oordra
veranderings.rede: 'deel van hoe' is a calque of 'part of how'; the Afrikaans construction keeps the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: 'n bron wat ons van die San se lewe vertel
veranderings.na: 'n bron wat vir ons van die San se lewe vertel
veranderings.rede: Without 'vir', 'wat ons' can be read as 'that we tell', so the relative clause is ambiguous.

veranderings.voor: om die vuur, sing en klap
veranderings.na: om die vuur, sing en klap hande
veranderings.rede: 'klap' on its own can mean to slap; 'hande klap' says clearly what the women do.
'string' is unnatural for people moving one behind the other; 'ry' is the ordinary word.

veranderings.voor: Jy praat elke dag en jy sien
veranderings.na: Jy praat elke dag, en jy sien
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
'daarby gekom' as two words reads as 'got there'; 'bygekom' is the natural verb for being added.

veranderings.voor: Om 'n boodskap by iemand anders uit te kry.
veranderings.na: Om 'n boodskap aan iemand anders oor te dra.
veranderings.rede: 'by iemand uitkry' is colloquial and calques 'get across'; 'aan iemand oordra' is the standard expression for a definition.
'een' stresses the number one; the indefinite article is the natural form here.
